# 💖 Ushka's Code of Conduct: Let's Be Awesome Together! 🎀

(Or: How Not to Be a Grumpy Cat in Our Cozy Community)

Welcome to Ushka's little corner of the internet! We believe in fostering a community that's as cute, minimalist, and delightful as Ushka herself. That means being welcoming, inclusive, and generally pleasant. If you can't manage that, well, there are other frameworks.

This Code of Conduct applies to all Ushka-related spaces, including our repositories, issue trackers, chat rooms (if we ever get one), and any events we might be crazy enough to organize.

---

## 🌟 Our Guiding Principles (The Golden Rules, but Cuter)

We expect everyone participating in the Ushka community to embrace these simple principles:

1.  **Be Kind and Inclusive:** Treat everyone with respect, regardless of their background, experience, or preferred kaomoji. We're all here to make Python cute again, not to make each other miserable.
2.  **Be Welcoming:** Newcomers are our future! Help them feel at home, answer their questions patiently (even if they're about how to install pip), and celebrate their first contributions.
3.  **Be Considerate:** Your words and actions have an impact. Think before you type (or speak). Avoid anything that could be perceived as harassment, discrimination, or just plain rude. We're building a framework, not a drama club.
4.  **Be Respectful of Differences:** Disagreements happen. It's fine to debate ideas, but always maintain a professional and respectful tone. Personal attacks are strictly off-limits. We're not throwing virtual catfights here.
5.  **Be Patient:** Ushka is still growing (and learning!). Contributions might take time to review, and answers might not be instantaneous. We're doing our best, promise!
6.  **Focus on the Work:** Keep discussions relevant to Ushka. Off-topic chatter is fine in appropriate social channels, but let's keep the issue tracker about making Ushka awesome.

---

## 🚫 Unacceptable Behaviors (Things That Make Ushka Frown)

The following behaviors are considered harassment and are unacceptable within our community:

*   Violent threats or language.
*   Discriminatory jokes and language.
*   Posting sexually explicit or violent material.
*   Posting or threatening to post people's personally identifying information ("doxing").
*   Personal insults, especially those directed at someone's technical abilities. (We all started somewhere, even the maintainers. Especially the maintainers.)
*   Unwelcome sexual attention.
*   Advocating for or encouraging any of the above behaviors.
*   Repeated harassment of others. If someone asks you to stop, *stop*.

---

## 🚨 Reporting Guidelines (When Things Go Wrong)

If you experience or witness unacceptable behavior, or have any other concerns, please notify the project maintainers immediately at [kleber.code@gmail.com](mailto:kleber.code@gmail.com). All reports will be reviewed and investigated promptly and fairly. We take these things seriously, because a happy community is a productive community.

Project maintainers are obligated to respect the privacy and security of the reporter of any incident.

---

## ⚖️ Enforcement (What Happens Next)

If a community member engages in unacceptable behavior, the project maintainers may take any action they deem appropriate, up to and including a temporary ban or permanent expulsion from the community. We'd rather not, but we will.

---

This Code of Conduct is adapted from the [Contributor Covenant](https://www.contributor-covenant.org), version 2.1, available at [https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html](https://www.contributor-covenant.org/version/2/1/code_of_conduct.html).
